stage: registered after implementation of the R1 baselines and their pilot validation on instances outside every released suite (seed 777001), and before any R1 run on a released suite, any reference re-check and any scoring of R1 records

scope.suite_holdout: idcon_hprd_h (references computed, kept out of the public repository; their SHA-256 is published as a commitment)
scope.removed_note: legacy material of an abandoned, never-submitted method draft; frozen v1 records are kept unchanged (git tag v1.0) but are not analysed in R1

methods.glasgow_staged_note: post hoc on idcon_hard/idcon_hprd (v1 Amendment 3, marked with a dagger); registered here in advance for idcon_hprd_x and the extended-budget runs

R1_main.schedule: hard_benchmark.run_shard (v1 seed, shuffled task order, randomised method order), prediction tag r1

R1_B10.pairs: every (task, method) pair whose 2 s run returned NO_ANSWER in at least one repeat (v1 records for v1 methods, R1_main records for enum_glasgow); pairs answered in both 2 s repeats are not rerun
R1_B10.purpose: does difficulty persist beyond the 2 s budget

R1_overhead.what: fixed per-call cost: time to write the host graph, and LAD2025 / Glasgow (default, --staged) on a one-role pattern; 20 calls each

runs.process_model: one timing worker pinned to vCPU 0; reference re-check, new-suite references and counts on vCPU 1; once that queue is empty a second timing worker continues the timing queue on vCPU 1 (two concurrent single-thread processes, as in v1); same 2-vCPU VM type as v1 (Linux-6.18.44-fc-v880-x86_64-with-glibc2.39)

references.hard: revision_references.recheck: (a) the 114 non-trivial negative states without second-engine corroboration in v1 are re-queried with Glasgow --staged (30 s), then CP-SAT (60 s); (b) the 3 tasks settled by the EG-ICAF consensus in v1 are re-settled with LAD2025, Glasgow --staged and CP-SAT (120 s each, per undetermined state), else UNASSESSED; a positive witness against any v1 negative aborts the re-check and is reported
references.new_suites: hard_benchmark.reference_task without EG-ICAF: construction-free; LAD2025 30 s per state query with Glasgow 30 s corroboration; LAD timeouts fall back to Glasgow 60 s, then CP-SAT 60 s; positive witnesses replayed
references.proof_logging: assessed, not used: Glasgow --prove rejects labelled inputs ("Proof logging cannot yet be used on labelled graphs"), which the unary-domain/metric encoding needs; on the smallest plain EMPTY task (unlabelled) Glasgow did not finish in 100 s without proof logging (LAD2025 0.12 s)
references.scoring: R1 tables use R1 references; tasks UNASSESSED after R1 are excluded from every denominator

analyses.A1_base_rate: first-match errors by reference label; check that every first-match error is an UNKNOWN reference (structural consequence of the definitions)
analyses.A2_soundness_gate: leaderboard: methods with any certified wrong outcome are listed separately and not ranked by PAR-2; PAR-10 (20 s at the 2 s budget) reported for wrong outcomes
analyses.A3_strata_uncertainty: per stratum (Hard: tier x variant; HPRD; HPRD-X: query size x density) ancestor-level paired bootstrap of PAR-2 (10,000 draws, family-stratified on Hard, seed 20261127) and the probability that each method has the lowest PAR-2
analyses.A4_learned_prior: HistGradientBoostingClassifier (scikit-learn defaults, random_state 0), leave-one-ancestor-out, features available without search: manifest metadata (family, tier, roles, construction, variant, scenario, generator parameters), ancestor statistics (host/pattern edges, components, anchors, metric edges) and observation-table statistics (per checked role: counts of S/U/V entities overall and among degree-feasible entities; number of checked roles with no S entity; global state); reported per suite as correct tasks
analyses.A5_automorphisms: lower bound on UNKNOWN references explained by pattern symmetry: generators of Aut(Q) that fix anchors, metric edges and unary domains (pynauty or NetworkX GraphMatcher on Q), applied to the construction embedding; a generator that changes the state certifies symmetry-induced UNKNOWN
analyses.A6_hprd_counts: distribution of embedding counts (full labels and IdCon identity space)
analyses.A8_budget_curves: completion curves to 10 s from R1_B10 combined with 2 s records
analyses.A9_reference_subsets: main table on all assessed references and on references with every non-trivial negative confirmed by a second engine
analyses.A10_registration_table: each reported analysis classified as v1-registered, v1-post hoc, R1-registered (this record) or R1-post hoc
